Residual own-use rows already absorbed into an upstream inclusive Common ESTO boundary are excluded using upstream component and non-expanding-rollup contributor metadata, not a dashboard mapping list.

total_demand_page.tfec_status: Temporarily disabled because non-energy use cannot yet be separated from aggregated Other-sector LEAP demand.
total_demand_page._note: supply_total = sum of signed values for codes 01 (Production), 02 (Imports), 03 (Exports), and the common 04-05 International transport (bunkers) comparison row. The combined bunker row is used in overview totals so its retained 04/05 source children are not counted again; the detailed children remain available on the Supply page. Bunkers are supply deductions and are excluded from domestic demand. Stock changes (06) remain outside the projection-comparable total. The transformation overview combines all flow-09 transformation sectors with flow 08 transfers, flow 10.01 energy-sector own use, and flow 10.02 transmission/distribution losses. Its by-flow areas use the deepest available non-overlapping flow nodes, while its net lines and by-fuel chart retain the authoritative whole-boundary frontier. Unmet Requirements remains a separate LEAP-only diagnostic: only its fuels are resolved to the selected Common ESTO category scope; positive values mean shortage and negative values mean surplus.

supply_page._note: Show international marine bunkers (04) and international aviation bunkers (05) separately on Supply when separate LEAP source branches are available. While the combined International transport placeholder is active, show their 04-05 parent instead so every dataset uses the same non-overlapping comparison boundary. The combined row remains available to the Energy balance overview for its supply total. Stock changes and statistical discrepancy are balancing rows rather than projection series. Source their base-year fuel values from the ESTO and LEAP comparison scope, label the boundary explicitly, and exclude them from ordinary line and area charts. For Statistical discrepancy only, multiply LEAP chart values by -1 to align the displayed sign with ESTO; do not take absolute values and do not change the upstream comparison fact. Missing 9th Outlook values are unavailable, not zero.

emissions_page._note: The Emissions page contains exactly two charts: emissions by fuel and emissions by major sector. The original-ESTO-flow policy at flow_policy_path is the authority for whether a balance row is included in the factor-based combustion estimate; measured_in_dashboard does not mean the source contains directly measured emissions. Extended Common ESTO rows inherit the longest original ESTO ancestor, and mixed included/excluded rollups fail closed. Final demand is split into Industry, Transport, Buildings, and Other demand. Negative power-sector transformation inputs and separately reported 10.01 energy-sector own use are treated as combustion. Conversion feedstocks (including refining, LNG/gas processing, coal transformation, petrochemicals and hydrogen production), positive outputs, transfers and 10.02 transmission/distribution losses are excluded. Non-energy and mixed final-consumption aggregates are excluded. Sources with no sector detail may use aggregate_flow_code 13 Total final energy consumption, which excludes non-energy use, without inventing a sector split. Factors and their mapping axis live in factor_sets_config_path; leave factor_set_key empty to use the active factor set. frontier_coverage_tolerance_pj is the PJ gap above which the page warns that retained detail does not add back to a reported aggregate.

leap_demand_sector_coverage._note: page_leap_branches maps each domestic demand page_key to its LEAP source branches. The dashboard workflow resolves aggregate-only sectors from leap_mappings/config/all_demand_aggregated_components.json. International transport is a signed supply deduction and is routed to Supply, not domestic demand. Exact flow 17 is presented in the Industry page's Non-energy use section; the combined Other sector including non-energy placeholder remains routed to Other demand by its explicit routing special case.

power_interim_branch_flow_prefixes._note: When an interim branch is retained in the upstream fallback audit, hide its Power detail cards. The page-level Power aggregates remain until each interim branch is replaced by its completed LEAP source branch.

scope_specific_pages._note: Optional diagnostic alternate-scope pages. Keep disabled by default until each page has been reviewed for production usefulness; when enabled, pages are generated only when matching rows exist in the input data.

secondary_pages._note: No secondary pages are published. International marine and aviation bunkers remain on Supply and in TPES without a duplicate International transport page.
